coordinates: pixels, x right, y down. Track columns without suffix are in frame-0-stabilised coordinates (background-referenced); *_orig columns are in raw frame pixels. Difference is <= ~9.5 px in x, ~2-5 px in y (see camera).

camera.drift: scene content shifts smoothly right by ~9 px and up by ~2 px (at curb centre) over the 55 frames (~0.17 px/frame x), rotation 0.18 deg total, no zoom (scale 1.000 +-0.0007)
camera.per_frame_transform_file: camera_transform.json (A maps frame-0 coords -> frame-i coords; shift_at_curb_* = background shift at curb level y=990)
camera.note: Rider moves ~18.7 px/frame, so drift is ~1% of the motion; stabilised columns already remove it.

perspective: Side view; rider travels right-to-left parallel to the image plane along the road just in front of the curb. Scooter length stays 201-205 px over frames 0-31 (and ~203 by visual check at frames 50, 54) -> constant depth, planar single-scale assumption is good.
